description: This file defines a utility function `aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost` for aggregating agent costs and usage metrics across various session and cost collections in a MongoDB database. It includes internal helper functions for parsing currency-like strings and performs complex aggregation pipelines to merge data from multiple sources, applying filters based on tenant, project, and date ranges.

methods.description: Main asynchronous function that aggregates agent usage and cost data from MongoDB collections, merging results from session_tracking and llm_costs collections, applying filters and sorting the summarized results.
